crew.overview: In Scooby-Doo’s greatest adventure yet, see the never-before told story of how lifelong friends Scooby and Shaggy first met and how they joined forces with young detectives Fred, Velma, and Daphne to form the famous Mystery Inc. Now, with hundreds of cases solved, Scooby and the gang face their biggest, toughest mystery ever: an evil plot to unleash the ghost dog Cerberus upon the world. As they race to stop this global “dogpocalypse,” the gang discovers that Scooby has a secret legacy and an epic destiny greater than anyone ever imagined.
crew.title: Scoob!

crew.overview: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.
crew.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home

details.biography: Chiranjiv Makwana is an Actor, Producer and Animation Director, born and raised in the city of Jamnagar, Gujarat. He is also know as Screenplay writer for the film Scoob! (2020). The film has won the Animated Oscar Awards for the Best Animated Production Design. He was born and brought up in Jamnagar, Gujarat. He was born on 13th July 1996 to Lakeshbhai Makwana, an English teacher and Vanitaben Makwana, a homemaker. He did his schooling at Bhavans Shree A.K. Doshi Vidyalaya in Jamnagar and completed his Chemical Engineering from the Industrial training institute of Jamnagar. He started his career in 2008. He is said to be in a relationship with Anupama Parameswaran, the multilingual actress and they are said to get married soon.
details.name: Chiranjiv Makwana
